semiconductor_relevance: High - Acoulab specializes in ultrasonic technology for inspection and analysis, which is critical in semiconductor R&D and quality control.
summary: Acoulab Co., Ltd. provides advanced Scanning Acoustic Microscopes (SAM) and ultrasonic technology solutions for research and development, failure analysis, quality control, and production inspection in the semiconductor industry. Established in 1998 in Korea, the company focuses on delivering cost-effective inspection solutions tailored to customer needs.

regional_presence.Korea: Acoulab is headquartered in Korea, leveraging its local expertise in ultrasonic technology.
